title: Jesse's interview with Puthoff and Weinstein on remote viewing

tellings.quote: It's funny he was touching on it in my interview with him and Eric Weinstein

plain: Michels says the physicist Hal Puthoff touched on remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe distant places or objects with the mind alone, when Michels interviewed him together with the mathematician and researcher Eric Weinstein. Michels brings this up himself, in passing, during an episode with a Navy scientist, and says nothing about what Puthoff actually said.
